description: This is a test source file for the 'compress_schema' functionality in the 'fastmcp.utilities.json_schema' module. It contains unit tests for various schema compression features, including pruning parameters, definitions, additional properties, and titles, and tests combined functionalities. The tests are written using pytest and include version checks for Python 3.10+. The filename indicates it belongs to tests within the MCP server extension of the openbb_platform project.

methods.description: Tests the pruning of definitions within the schema.

methods.name: test_prune_additional_properties()
methods.description: Tests the pruning of additionalProperties in the schema.
